courses.title: Meditate on Self: Heal, Empower & Awaken Within
courses.description: A self-paced programme in seven steps from Romi Ochwani combining meditation, breathwork, energy awareness and journaling. It is aimed at beginners and experienced meditators who want a steady daily practice and a clearer sense of themselves.

free_resources.title: After Trauma: A Three-Part Educational Series on Healing
free_resources.description: A free three-part interview series in which Romi Ochwani talks with a psychologist about what trauma is, how it shows up in the body and in reactive patterns, and how a sense of safety supports recovery. It is offered as education, not as care.

left_out: Insight Timer course 'Awaken To Your True Self: A Journey Of Healing And Self-Discovery' and the Portuguese gratitude/forgiveness course: Insight Timer is never fetched, so not verified.
flags: After Trauma is an educational interview with a psychologist (Marina) and says it is not a substitute for mental health care; kept as education, but a human may see it as therapy-adjacent.
